2608.02089.title: How Much Does a Reasoning Summary Reveal? An Observability Ladder for Large Language Models
2608.02089.paper_summary: Large language models often show users a final response and a short reasoning summary while the full reasoning trace stays hidden. We introduce an observability ladder that holds each completed run fixed and varies only what a reader inspects to judge whether the answer is correct: the response, a self-summary the model writes from the trace, the trace itself, and internal signals, each with and without the prompt. Across three benchmarks and five open-weight Qwen3 and gpt-oss models, we train matched linear correctness predictors on each access level. Without the prompt, summaries carry most of the trace's ranking signal (mean AUROC 0.774 versus 0.813) and add +0.156 over the response alone. With the prompt visible, the summary's gain collapses to +0.019, while the trace still adds +0.041. Even at equal length, the trace's last words predict correctness as well as summaries, or slightly better, and carry denser and more discriminative uncertainty and self-correction cues. On MMLU-Pro questions with both correct and incorrect runs, linear summary readers are near chance and trace readers retain only modest signal, both with and without the prompt (prompt-withheld AUROC 0.503-0.545 versus 0.544-0.590). With the prompt withheld, a GPT-5-mini reader recovers substantially more signal from both summaries and traces on gpt-oss-20b, and even then the trace keeps a small +0.034 advantage. Much of the linear readers' trace signal is associated with length. In the common case where users already hold the prompt, summaries are less helpful than the full trace for monitoring correctness. Monitorability is thus a joint property of the display and the reader, so any monitorability claim, including for faithfulness, should specify both.
2608.02089.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型通常會向用戶顯示最終回應和簡短的推理摘要，而完整的推理過程則保持隱藏。我們引入了一個可觀察性階梯，固定每次完成的運行，僅變化讀者檢查的內容，以判斷答案是否正確：回應、模型從過程中寫出的自我摘要、過程本身以及內部信號，每個都有和沒有提示。 在三個基準和五個開放權重的Qwen3和gpt-oss模型中，我們在每個訪問級別上訓練了匹配的線性正確性預測器。 在沒有提示的情況下，摘要攜帶了大部分過程的排名信號（平均AUROC 0.774對比0.813），並在僅回應的基礎上增加了+0.156。 當提示可見時，摘要的增益降至+0.019，而過程仍然增加+0.041。 即使在相同長度下，過程的最後幾個字預測正確性與摘要一樣好，甚至稍微更好，並攜帶更密集和更具區分性的不確定性和自我修正線索。 在MMLU-Pro問題中，無論是正確還是錯誤的運行，線性摘要讀者的表現接近隨機，而過程讀者僅保留適度的信號，無論有無提示（提示隱藏的AUROC 0.503-0.545對比0.544-0.590）。 在提示被隱藏的情況下，GPT-5-mini讀者從gpt-oss-20b的摘要和過程中恢復了更多的信號，即便如此，過程仍保持小幅+0.034的優勢。 大多數線性讀者的過程信號與長度相關。在用戶已經持有提示的常見情況下，摘要對於監控正確性來說不如完整過程有幫助。因此，可監控性是顯示和讀者的共同特性，因此任何可監控性聲明，包括對於忠實性的聲明，都應該具體說明兩者。
